timezone.meaning: Use an installed ZoneInfo name and switch to manual. Cannot be supplied with automatic_timezone true; HomeServer keeps UTC. Supply at least one supported setting.

ntp_enabled.meaning: Enable or disable system NTP. HomeServer does not allow false.

automatic_timezone.meaning: Follow the household timezone when true, select manual when false. HomeServer does not allow false.

time_format.meaning: Choose the Waybar clock format when the owner config includes its clock override.

local_time.meaning: Unambiguous local wall time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM with NTP off; unavailable on HomeServer.

receipt.meaning: Settings act metadata: ok, changed, kind, fields, backups and commands. A failure retains metadata about what ran, even after compensation.

receiptPath.meaning: Path of the saved settings run.json on success.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Whether the stop reports a performed mutation.

changed.meaning: Whether a clock command completed or an applicable config change was recorded.

readback.meaning: Observed settings when applicable: timezone, automatic_timezone, ntp_enabled, local_time, time_format, waybar_reload and household_zone. It may be partial or empty on failure.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal outcomes emitted by the stop and its envelope reader. The envelope reader can also emit missing envelope kernel keys: followed by the comma-joined missing keys. An unrecognized payload key is returned as unknown-field:<key>. Other ValueError text can pass through.
